summary_en: WOLVES HAND authorized the acquisition of up to 100,000 shares (1.3% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥3,000 million through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 13, 2026 to October 12, 2027, to mitigate stock supply-demand effects from a concurrent public offering.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Related to Treasury Stock Acquisition
translation_en_brief:
On September 2, 2026, WOLVES HAND's board of directors authorized the company to acquire up to 100,000 of its common shares at a maximum expenditure of ¥3,000 million through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from October 13, 2026 through October 12, 2027. Based on the issued share count of 7,565,600 shares (excluding treasury stock) as of July 31, 2026, the 100,000 shares represent 1.3 percent of outstanding shares.

The primary reason for the buyback is to mitigate the impact on stock supply and demand resulting from a concurrent public offering announced on the same date. The company noted that market conditions may prevent full or partial execution of the authorized repurchase program.
